matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Defense vs. Pass Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass defense grades 84/100 (among the NFL's best) against NYJ's pass offense at 52/100 (about average) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: The Jets bring a top-five defense to Gillette, but here's the thing: their pass offense is just about average, and our pass defense is genuinely elite—that's the widest edge we've got on the board this week, and it's a big one. The real test is their pass rush, which grades at 94/100 and will test our 52/100 pass protection relentlessly; if we can keep Aaron Rodgers clean enough, we should be able to operate through the air. On the ground, it's a nasty matchup—their run defense is elite at 81/100 while ours sits at 32/100, so don't expect us to move the ball with our legs. The good news? We've beaten the Jets in three of the last five head-to-head meetings, including two convincing wins last season, and we're coming in hotter on recent form. This is a winnable game if our pass defense shows up the way it has been, but we can't afford to beat ourselves with protection breakdowns.
